name: Orc Mob

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: At the start of the Orc player's turn, roll a D6 for each Orc or Goblin Henchman not in hand-to-hand combat. On a 1 the warrior takes offense; roll a second die: 1 'I 'Erd Dat!' - charges and fights a round of combat against the nearest friendly Orc/Goblin Henchman or Hired Sword within charge reach (models then move 1" apart); if none, shoots at the nearest one with a missile weapon; if none or nearest is an Orc Hero, treat as 2-5. He takes no other action but may defend himself. 2-5 'Wud Yoo Say?' - does nothing else this turn but may defend himself. 6 'I'll Show Yer!' - must move as quickly as possible towards the nearest enemy, charging if possible; this move is in addition to his regular move.

specialRules.name: Distasteful Company
specialRules.text: Orcs may only hire these Hired Swords: Pit Fighters, Ogre Bodyguards or Warlocks.

specialRules.name: Characteristic maximums
specialRules.text: Orc profile maximums: M4 WS6 BS6 S4 T5 W3 I5 A4 Ld9. Henchmen can only add +1 to any characteristic.

specialRules.name: Orc special skills
specialRules.text: Orc Heroes may use this Skill list instead of any standard list: 'Ard 'Ead: 5+ save to avoid being stunned; if made treat stunned as knocked down. With a helmet the save is 3+ (replaces the Helmet rule). Waaagh!: +D3" to charge range. 'Ere We Go!: May ignore Fear and Terror tests when charging. Da Cunnin' Plan: Boss only. Warband may re-roll failed Rout tests while the Boss is not out of action. Well 'Ard: +1 to any armour saves. 'Eadbasher: Any knocked down results the Orc causes in hand-to-hand combat count as stunned instead.

equipmentLists.name: Orc equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Orc Boss, Orc Shaman, Orc Big 'Uns, Orc Boyz

items.name: Squig Prodder
items.note: Common (Goblins only). Treated as a spear; lets a Goblin keep all Cave Squigs within 12" from going wild instead of 6".

items.name: Ball & Chain
items.note: Common (Goblins only). Close combat, Strength as user +2; Incredible Force, Random, Two-handed, Cumbersome, Unwieldy. Only usable under the influence of Mad Cap Mushrooms.

items.name: Mad Cap Mushrooms
items.note: Common if the warband includes Goblins.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" of the Orc Boss may use his Leadership when taking Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.text: Uses Waaagh! Magic.

specialRules.name: No armour
specialRules.text: May not wear armour.

fighters.name: Orc Boy

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: See warband Animosity rule.

fighters.notes: Bought in groups of 1-5. Any number allowed.

fighters.name: Goblin Warrior

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: See warband Animosity rule.

specialRules.name: Not Orcs
specialRules.text: When testing for Rout, a Goblin or Cave Squig taken out of action only counts as half a model.

specialRules.name: Runts
specialRules.text: May gain experience, but on a Heroes advance roll of 'That Lad's got talent' (henchman advance) he is killed by the Orc overlords and removed from the roster.

specialRules.name: Animosity note
specialRules.text: A Goblin who fails his Animosity test and rolls a 1 on the chart will still not charge an Orc Henchman, but may use missile weapons to attack as normal.

fighters.notes: Bought in groups of 1-5. May not have more than two Goblins for each Orc in the warband (including Orc Heroes); max left open.

fighters.name: Cave Squig
fixedEquipment: Natural weapons (never use or need weapons or armour)

specialRules.name: Movement
specialRules.text: No set Movement: roll 2D6 for the distance moved. Never run or declare charges, but may contact enemy models with their normal 2D6 movement; if so they count as charging.

specialRules.name: Minderz
specialRules.text: Must stay within 6" of a Goblin. If not within 6" of a Goblin at the start of its Movement phase it goes wild: move 2D6" in a random direction each Movement phase, engaging any model contacted; out of the Orc player's control until the end of the game.

specialRules.name: Not Orcs
specialRules.text: As Goblin Warriors (counts as half a model for Rout tests).

specialRules.name: Animals
specialRules.text: Do not gain experience.

fighters.notes: Bought in groups of 1-5. May never have more Cave Squigs than Goblin Warriors. Movement printed as 2D6.

fighters.name: Troll
fixedEquipment: Natural weapons / club (never given weapons or armour)

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.text: Causes fear.

specialRules.name: Stupidity
specialRules.text: Subject to the rules for stupidity.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.text: Whenever an enemy inflicts a wound, roll a D12; on a 7+ the wound is ignored. Not regenerated against fire or fire-based magic. Never rolls for Injury after a battle.

specialRules.name: Dumb Monster
specialRules.text: Never learns skills and gains no experience.

specialRules.name: Always Hungry
specialRules.text: Upkeep: warband must pay 15 gc after every game; otherwise the Boss may sacrifice two Goblin Warriors or Cave Squigs, or the Troll wanders off.

specialRules.name: Vomit Attack
specialRules.text: Instead of normal attacks, a single attack that automatically hits at Strength 5 and ignores armour saves.

fighters.notes: 0-1 Troll; bought as a single model. Hired in a group of one.

conversionNotes: Animosity: D6 roll of 1 left as 1 on the D12 (not in the standard conversion table); result chart 1 / 2-5 / 6 left as printed - human to rescale for D12 (suggest 1 / 2-11 / 12).
Ball and Chain 'Random' D6 table and 'out permanently on 1-3 instead of 1-2' left as printed; they need human rescaling for D12.
Waaagh! Magic spell table (D6 list with difficulties 6-9) and Goblin 'That Lad's got talent' advance roll not converted; spell list is referenced by name only.
Cave Squig M is printed as 2D6 and stored as a string.
Goblin Warriors limited to two per Orc (including Orc Heroes) - max left null; Cave Squigs limited by Goblin count.
Troll hire cost 200 gc; Goblins and Cave Squigs use the Goblin equipment list / none; Squig Prodder, Ball & Chain and Mad Cap Mushrooms are in the Goblin list as misc (Goblins only).
Shaman uses the Orc list but may not wear armour.
